scope: Full simulator navigation, original high-level decision making, perception, mapping, instance reporting and stopping.
baseline: Previously accepted original MOST-Nav runs from the same episode manifest.
treatment: Frozen seed-11 environment JEPA with a learned longer-horizon value and episode-local observation memory, applied when the native host provides valid candidates. Charge real scan actions to the same episode budget.
primary_outputs: unique officially credited targets per episode
total unique hits capped by each episode quota
diagnostic_outputs: distinct instances that entered the official reporting range
visually exposed instances under a stated threshold
repeated or empty reports and in-range unreported targets
eligible exploration decisions, scored decisions, and executed changes of direction
scan overhead and native fallback reasons
diagnostic_replay: Enumerate compatible native frontier decisions in all five frozen historical fixed-arm episodes. At each compatible decision replay its exact prefix, spend four physical scan turns and execute each candidate's 24 actions separately. The seed-11 V13 cold-start policy makes a local choice using current RGB and plans only. Treat this as a local mechanism check.
inference: Report accepted episodes and incomplete or engineering-interrupted episodes separately. The five paired development episodes were reused previously and do not estimate 300-episode generalization. Independent hosted model requests may yield different high-level decisions.
